end.summary: Discussed Diwali customs: cleaning, rangoli, sweets, new clothes, and lights.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised identifying why Pongal and Baisakhi use different crops and occur in different months. They first mixed up the reason for new rice and whether festival dates were random, then corrected this by connecting each festival to its harvest season and crop. At home, ask Kavya to explain one harvest festival using the pattern: place, month, and crop.
